input.rationale: Section 7.5 does contain a transition mechanic triggered by the Servicer's resignation or termination (7.5(a) cooperation; 7.5(b) transfer of Receivable Files and records), so element 1 of the fallback is already met. However, the clause fails the fallback on two material terms: there is no minimum transition assistance period (Section 7.3 only requires the Servicer to continue until a Successor Servicer accepts engagement or until the date stated in the termination notice, which can be shorter than 90 days), and delivery of the Receivable Files and records is governed only by an open-ended \"as soon as practicable\" standard with no 30-day outside date. We therefore propose the shortest fallback-level cure: a 90-day assistance period and a 30-day backstop for delivery. We have not pursued the preferred certified-deletion and machine-readable-format elements, and we leave the Section 7.5(b) carve-back for processes, models and servicing software untouched (that point sits with the IP rule).

proposal.summary: Add a 90-day transition assistance period and a 30-day outside date for delivery of the Receivable Files and records in Section 7.5.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] Section 7.5 requires cooperation but sets no minimum assistance period and only an open-ended "as soon as practicable" delivery standard, so we added our fallback position: at least 90 days of transition assistance and delivery of the Receivable Files and records within 30 days of the effective date of resignation or termination.

ops.text: Transition Assistance Period. The predecessor Servicer will provide the transition assistance described in this Section 7.5 for at least ninety (90) days after the effective date of its resignation or termination, and in any event will deliver the Receivable Files and the accounts and records maintained by the Servicer to the Successor Servicer no later than thirty (30) days after such effective date.

mappings.element: Transition obligations apply on expiry or termination.
mappings.quote: (a) Cooperation on Termination. On its resignation or termination, the Servicer will cooperate with the Issuer, the Owner Trustee, the Indenture Trustee and the Successor Servicer in effecting (i) the termination of its rights and obligations under this Agreement and (ii) an orderly transition of such rights and obligations to the Successor Servicer.
